findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: Inspector observed no soap available at the bar handwashing sink. CORRECTED- person in charge (PIC) placed hand soap at the sink, to be hung from a hook moving forward (also discussed installing a soap dispenser- as long as it is available and functional, it is in compliance with the food code). Ensure hand washing sinks are always supplied with warm running water, soap, and paper towels to allow for proper hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no soap available at the bar handwashing sink at the start of today’s inspection. CORRECTED- person in charge (PIC) placed hand soap at the sink. Ensure hand washing sinks are always supplied with warm running water, soap, and paper towels (or a high velocity hand dryer) to incentivize proper hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no probe thermometer available at the facility. CORRECTED- PIC found a probe thermometer during inspection. All facilities heating temperature control for food safety (TCS) foods should have a probe thermometer available to measure internal temperature of foods to ensure foods are reaching temperature benchmarks.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.12 Food Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small-diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets. [Pf]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
One container each of beer cheese and marinara sauce were more than 7 days past their labeled open-dates (11/23 and 11/18 respectively). CORRECTED- Both were voluntarily discarded. Ensure foods are not held for more than 7 days after opening. 
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. [P]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
No sanitizer bucket was prepared in the kitchen upon inspector’s arrival. Ensure a sanitizer bucket is prepared prior to beginning any food prep, and is available during all times of operation. CORRECTED- PIC prepared a sanitizer bucket, observed at 100ppm Cl.
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. [Pf]

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Boxes of cups and lids observed stored on the floor in the basement. Store single-service items at least 6 inches above the ground to prevent potential contamination and to allow for cleaning.
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Bare wood shelves in the under-counter cooler have been covered with a plastic covering on the top, but bare wood remains exposed. Paint or otherwise seal the bare wood so it’s smooth & easily cleanable, and no longer absorbent.
4-101.11: (A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be: (B) Durable, nonabsorbent, and CORROSION-RESISTANT (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion. [C]

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
Provide self-closers on both restroom doors. Self closing hinges have been purchased but have not been installed yet.
6-202.14: Toilet rooms located on PREMISES shall be completely enclosed and provided with tightfitting and self-closing door. [C]
